gloss: in small steps; bit by bit; tremblingly

definitions.gloss: in small steps; in small increments; bit by bit
definitions.explanation: Doing something in small, frequent amounts or movements rather than all at once.
Shaking or trembling with small, rapid movements, often from cold, fear, or nervousness.

examples.japanese: {小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price is rising in small increments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Taking breaks in small, frequent intervals is more efficient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: My body trembled from the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{震|ふる}えている→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: My hands are trembling slightly from nervousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{震|ふる}えていた→震える：02411_furueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{抱|だ}き{上|あ}げて⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The dog was trembling with fear, so I picked it up.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + {刻|きざ}み (intervals/increments) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial particle). Literally 'in small intervals.'

SENSE 1 — SMALL INCREMENTS:
Describes doing something in small, frequent amounts rather than all at once.
- {小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to take small steps
- {小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move in small increments
- {小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take frequent short breaks

SENSE 2 — TREMBLING:
Specifically paired with ⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧ to describe rapid, small shaking from cold, fear, or nervousness.
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to shiver from cold
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小刻|こきざ}みに⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to tremble from nervousness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小刻|こきざ}みに: small, rapid increments
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little (gradual, not necessarily rapid)
